title: Large Language Diffusion Models
blurb: Trains an 8B masked diffusion language model from scratch and shows it competes with autoregressive models of similar size, including on in-context learning and instruction following.
intro: LLaDA replaces next-token prediction with masked diffusion: a bidirectional Transformer predicts all masked tokens of a sequence corrupted at a random rate $t$, with a $1/t$-weighted loss. Sampling starts from an all-mask answer and unmasks it over several steps. The steps build the corruption and loss, guidance and the bidirectional mask predictor; the capstone is the semi-autoregressive sampler with low-confidence remasking.
